app.name: BangDream Editor
projects.header.title: Project manager
projects.header.description: Sorted by recently opened. One project is one song, with one or more charts.
projects.newBlankDesc: Pick a difficulty and start writing; add audio and cover in project detail
projects.newCopyDesc: Keep a draft, or swap audio later
projects.guide.title: Start with your first project
projects.guide.description: A project is one song with one or more charts; creating one leaves you on its detail page so you can fill in details before entering the workspace.
projects.empty.title: No projects yet
projects.empty.description: Start blank: pick a difficulty and add a chart. Audio and cover can come later.
projects.sort.name: Project name
projects.uploadsEmpty: No charts uploaded to Bestdori yet.
projects.deleteLastChart: A project must keep at least one chart
projects.copyHint: Copies project info, audio, cover, and every chart. Chart status is not copied (all copies are unfinished).
projects.name: Project name
projects.newHint: Everything is optional. Import audio on the audio page. Cover and song source go in Edit project info. To paste chart JSON, add a chart after creating.
projects.coverHint: Charts with an empty title follow the project name. Import audio on the audio page.
projects.uploadedReadonly: Uploaded charts are read-only. Duplicate the chart to edit.
projects.chartNameHint: Leave empty to follow the project name (currently “{{name}}”). This is the Bestdori title.
projects.chartCodePlaceholder: Paste Bestdori-style JSON, or leave empty for a blank chart
projects.chartCodeHint: You can also paste later in the workspace chart-code editor.
projects.confirmDelete: Note: its audio, cover, and {{charts}} charts will be deleted.
projects.confirmDeleteUploaded: {{count}} of them were uploaded to Bestdori; deleting the project does not affect those posts.
workspace.readonlyPrompt: Uploaded charts cannot be modified. Duplicate this chart to edit?
settings.header.title: Settings
settings.header.description: Changes apply immediately and save automatically. Risky actions ask for confirmation.
settings.appearance.intro: Theme, UI font, and type size affect the editor chrome (nav, settings, dialogs), not the chart canvas.
settings.uiTypeScale.hint: Relative size of editor chrome text (nav, settings, dialogs) versus factory (70%–150%)
settings.uiFont.hint: Sans fallback stacks. Does not follow interface language. Monospace is unchanged.
settings.layout.intro: Panel collapse, width, and canvas zoom are adjusted in the workspace.
settings.layout.emptyDescription: Drag or use the header buttons to fold tool/property panels; the left nav can collapse to icons; Ctrl+wheel zooms the canvas.
settings.canvas.intro: How notes, lanes, and guides look on the canvas. Changes apply immediately.
settings.noteSize.hint: Note size relative to lane width
settings.slideOpacity.hint: Opacity of Slide ribbons; lower is fainter
settings.simultaneousClickLines.hint: Connect notes that share a beat on the same horizontal line
settings.colorAssist.hint: Singles off half-beat integers render as ghost taps so fine timing is visible by shape
settings.verticalRatio.hint: Height per measure (orthogonal to overall zoom)
settings.imageQuality.hint: Canvas render quality; Standard is the default
settings.gridStyle.hint: Grid color tiers: downbeats brightest, then darker (still readable on black)
settings.lineShapeTiers.hint: When on, line dash style follows tier (solid / long dash / short dash / dotted). When off, downbeats are solid and others are short dashes.
settings.gridOpacity.hint: Overall opacity of beat and subdivision grid lines
settings.labelScale.hint: Scale of canvas labels (BPM numbers / END) and live readouts
settings.reset.hint: Reset this group (canvas display) to factory values. Other settings stay.
settings.data.intro: Where charts and assets are stored, plus import/export of theme, shortcuts, and other preferences.
settings.dataRoot.readFail: Could not read the current save location
settings.prefs.hint: Theme, UI font and type size, layout, shortcuts, and canvas display.
settings.importFail: Import failed: the file is not valid settings JSON.
audio.header.title: Audio and Key Sounds
audio.header.description: Project audio, key-sound packs, and note SE volume.
audio.formats: Any format the browser can decode.
audio.loaded: Loaded · chart duration locked to audio length
audio.clearTitle: You will need to import audio again after clearing
audio.emptyDescription: You can edit without audio. After import, chart duration follows the file.
audio.duration.projectLocked: Locked because a chart in this project has been uploaded
audio.duration.manual: Editable when there is no audio
audio.lockedPrompt: Duplicate this project or create a new project before changing audio
audio.noProjectDescription: Audio belongs to a chart project. Open one on the projects page, then come back to manage its audio.
audio.jumpManageTitle: Go to the Audio page to set up this project's audio (without switching current project).
audio.decodeFallback: This file could not be decoded as audio. Try another file.
audio.keysound.intro: Key sounds follow hit style. Use ▶ to preview; switching saves immediately.
audio.dirPreviewAria: Directional flick preview by chord width
audio.keysound.note: Applies to later playback immediately. Sounds already playing pick up the new pack after pause/replay. Preview volume follows SE volume.
audio.se.intro: Key-sound volume. Does not affect BGM.
audio.seReset.hint: Reset SE volume to factory 100%. Does not change the key-sound pack.
scope.triggerTitle: Scope: the project this page acts on
scope.panelAria: Choose the project this page acts on
scope.lockedOption: Has an uploaded chart: audio can't be replaced or cleared
scope.gone: That project was deleted — back to the current project
scope.chartGone: That chart was deleted — back to the current chart
preview.chart.triggerTitle: Which chart this view is showing
preview.chart.triggerAria: Chart being previewed: {{title}} — click to switch
preview.static.empty: This chart has no notes yet — draw something first, then come back for the overview.
preview.display.title: Display settings
preview.static.exportDownscaled: Exported at a lower density to stay within canvas limits
preview.video.pending: The simulation field isn't implemented yet.
preview.video.assetsMissing: Field / background assets aren't archived locally yet. Run this once (idempotent, safe to re-run):
preview.noProjectDescription: Preview acts on one chart of a chart project. Open or create a project on the projects page first.
keysound.slide.hint: While dragging a slide or long note
keysound.directional.hint: Directional flicks, split by chord width 1–3
assets.header.title: Visual Assets
assets.header.description: Note and background skins. Key-sound packs live on the Audio page. Changes apply and save immediately.
assets.bg.help: Scope, fit, and opacity are in the card below. Stored on this device only.
assets.bg.emptyDescription: Upload PNG / JPEG / WebP (≤20MB). Stored on this device only.
assets.bg.sizeError: Image too large (max 20MB). Compress and retry.
assets.bg.saveError: Could not save the background. Retry.
assets.bg.scope.hint: Outside lanes = only the gutters stay pictured; the track stays the original dark canvas. Full canvas = immersive fill (track is dimmed).
assets.bg.fit.hint: Cover = scale to fill and crop. Contain = scale to fit and letterbox.
assets.bg.opacity.hint: Lower opacity shows more of the original black canvas. 0% black — 100% full image. Default 55%.
assets.bg.note: Takes effect on the canvas immediately. Hide keeps the image; Clear deletes it.
shortcuts.header.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.header.description: Filter from the sidebar or search, then click a binding to record. Conflicts are blocked before save.
shortcuts.resetAll: Reset all shortcuts to factory defaults
shortcuts.resetBucket: Reset only editable shortcuts in this index
shortcuts.resetSearch: Reset only editable shortcuts matching the current search
shortcuts.emptySearchHint: Try another query or clear the search box.
shortcuts.recorder.meta: {{label}}  ·  Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
toolbar.title: Tools
toolbar.pasteEmpty: Paste (clipboard empty — copy with Ctrl+C first)
toolbar.noteCodeHint:
{{tooltip}}
Click a note to view its code; Ctrl+B opens the note under the cursor
curve.title: Curve
play.timeInput: Type mm:ss or mm:ss.s and press Enter (clamped to chart length)
editor.markerHint: Double-click the blank area on the left side of the track to set the playback start point
editor.markerJumpTooltip: Jump to playback start and play · Shortcut: {{key}}
editor.markerJumpAria: Jump to playback start and play
canvas.passedNotes: Notes that have passed the judgement line
noteInfo.title: Note Info
chartCode.open: Open full chart code (always the whole chart, ignoring selection)
chartCode.selectionHint: {{count}} notes selected; this view still shows the full chart. To copy the selection, use Copy as chart code.
chartCode.stale: Code is stale (canvas changed {{count}} notes). Applying will overwrite canvas edits.
chartCode.confirmClose: Note: these edits will be lost when the editor closes.
chartCode.alertErrors.one: {{count}} error; not applied (see the list above)
chartCode.alertErrors.other: {{count}} errors; not applied (see the list above)
chartCode.alertErrorsApply.one: Chart code has {{count}} error; not applied (see the list above)
chartCode.alertErrorsApply.other: Chart code has {{count}} errors; not applied (see the list above)
chartCode.needBpm0: The chart must include a BPM note on beat 0. Cannot apply.
chartCode.confirmOverwriteTitle: Overwrite {{count}} note changes on the canvas?
chartCode.confirmOverwrite: Note: applying replaces those canvas changes with the version in the code.
chartCode.applyOk: Chart code applied to the editor
chartCode.applyFail: Apply failed; rolled back to the last applied state: {{message}}
chartCode.copyOk: Chart code copied to the clipboard
validate.noConnections: {{label}} must not keep a connections field
validate.noConnectionsExpected: Remove connections (it belongs only to type:"Slide")
validate.bpm0Negative: BPM on beat 0 must not be negative (chart seconds would be ≤ 0)
validate.lastBpmNegative: The last BPM event must not be negative (a chart ending on negative BPM crashes the official editor)
validate.lastBpmExpected: > 0 (must return to positive BPM after a reverse section)
validate.mustBeArray: Chart code must be an array
validate.noteMustBeObject: Each note must be an object
validate.typeExpected: BPM / Single / Directional / Slide / Long / System
validate.bpmNotFinite: BPM note bpm must be a finite number
validate.bpmNotZero: BPM note bpm must not be 0
validate.dirInvalid: Directional flick direction must be Left or Right
noteCode.targetGone: Target note no longer exists (the chart may have changed)
noteCode.notSlide: That note is not a slide/long note, so it has no nodes to write back
noteCode.convertFail: That code could not be converted to a note
noteCode.lostBpm0: This edit would remove the BPM note on beat 0
noteCode.lostBpm0Expected: Keep a BPM note on beat 0 (ADR-0001)
noteCode.targetNotSlide: Target note is missing or is not a slide (the chart may have changed)
noteCode.spanGone: Target span no longer exists (the chart may have changed)
noteCode.segmentConvertFail: That code could not be converted to a slide span
electron.changeDataRoot: Choose a new save location (an empty folder becomes the root; otherwise save into a child folder with the current name)
electron.moveFail: Move failed; still using the previous save location
electron.destInside: Cannot move the data root into itself or its parent
electron.destOccupied: "{{leaf}}" already exists at the destination and is not empty. Pick another location or use “Use existing data folder”.
